text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing,
I spotted Narita Top Road making preparations for a soccer event.

She was invited to coach the young kids, but—
unable to just watch her struggle with the workload,
I decided to lend a hand.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
—The ball went over to you!
—I'm gonna score this myself!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, it looks so fun.
Everyone seems to be getting along so well—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(That girl sitting over there... Is she not joining in?
Looks like she's looking down, though...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...
Um, excuse me!
I'll be right back!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Hello! Hey, wanna chat with me?
I'm no good at soccer, so I'm bored~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
You've got that soccer kid vibe going on, but...
Aren't you going to go play today?

text_block_list.name: Timid Boy
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Unlike everyone else, I'm not very good at it.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Going somewhere full of talented girls is
kind of intimidating, isn't it?
I used to feel the exact same way.

text_block_list.name: Timid Boy
text_block_list.text:
In the past... What did you do back then?
Big Sis, in times like this...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, for me...
I guess it all started with my mom.

text_block_list.name: Young Dantsu
text_block_list.text: "Wait, are you really going over to those girls?"

text_block_list.name: Young Dantsu
text_block_list.text:
"B-But I'm bad at jump rope...
I'll just get in everyone's way."

text_block_list.name: Dants's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"‘Don’t worry, you won't be a bother at all.
All you need to do is have as much fun as you can.’"

text_block_list.name: Dants's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Doesn't seeing your other friends having fun make you happy too?"

text_block_list.name: Dants's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"‘So go out there and enjoy yourself to the fullest.
Free and easy, just like you always do.’"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, wanna come with me?
To play soccer, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Timid Boy
text_block_list.text:
Huh, but I can't do it as well as everyone else.
They'll laugh at me...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally no good at it either~.
But you know, that's exactly why—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I plan to enjoy this to the fullest!
So come on, let's have fun together!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! Please let me join in too.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "We're still total amateurs, but we look forward to working with you!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, please, come on in!
Everyone, we have a new friend! Let's all have fun playing together, okay?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Lookin' forward to working with you~!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Wah! Whoa-whoa! The ball's coming this way!
Umm, umm—!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(Anyway...!
I have to get this ball over to her!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Heeeeyaaaaah.
...! Yeah, this looks like a great spot!"

text_block_list.name: Timid Boy
text_block_list.text:
W-Wah!?
W-What do I do? A shot, out of nowhere—

text_block_list.name: Boy Participating in Event
text_block_list.text: Just give it a good, hard kick! It feels great!

text_block_list.name: Girl Participating in Event
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, leave the backup to me!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Go on, just relax and give it your all!

text_block_list.name: Timid Boy
text_block_list.text:
...!
Yeah! —...Hiyah!!

text_block_list.name: Timid Boy
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, big sis.
Scoring a goal was so much fun.
And also—

text_block_list.name: Timid Boy
text_block_list.text:
None of them were scary.
...They were kind.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I see, sounds like you had a great experience.

text_block_list.name: Timid Boy
text_block_list.text:
"I think I'll join the soccer clinic again!
Next time, it'll just be me... but still..."

text_block_list.name: Timid Boy
text_block_list.text:
I made friends, too!
So I'm totally fine now!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Yeah—!

text_block_list.name: Timid Boy
text_block_list.text:
Bye-bye, Big Sis.
Thank you so much for today!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I had lots of fun too~!
See ya! Let's meet again sometime~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
............
And off they go!
choice_data_list: Maybe Dantsu has a talent for being a Trainer.
Maybe Dantsu has a talent for being a Trainer, you know?
I think it was good for her, too.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
............
And off they go!
choice_data_list: Maybe Dantsu has a talent for being a Trainer.
Maybe Dantsu has a talent for being a Trainer, you know?
I think it was good for her, too.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: N-No way! You're giving me way too much credit~...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Still... honestly, it was fun.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
When she crossed the finish line—I'm confident
I pumped my fist harder in my heart than anyone else.
choice_data_list: I know exactly how you feel.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Heh. Ah...... geez.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“...... I'm just parroting what my mom said,
but did I do well, I wonder?”
choice_data_list: Yeah, she'll pass it on to someone else too.
Yeah, she'll pass it on to someone else, too.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "Fufu. I hope today's experience will prove useful for her someday."
